questions.s: The following expenditure shall be charged on the consolidated fund of India, except
o: Debt charges for which the government of India is liable
Salaries, allowances and pensions payable to or in respect of Supreme Court judges
The pensions payable to or in respect of judges of any high court
The pensions payable to or in respect of governors of any state
questions.x: Under Article 112(3), debt charges, Supreme Court judges' pay and High Court judges' pensions are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India. Governors' pensions are not.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the money bill all of the following are correct, except
o: Whether a bill is money bill or not the decision of the speaker of the Lok Sabha shall be final
After the speaker's certificate on money bill, it shall not be open to question either in a court of Law or in either house or even by the president
Money bills shall be introduced in Lok Sabha only
President may return money bill for reconsideration
questions.x: The President cannot return a Money Bill for reconsideration (Article 111). He may only assent or withhold assent.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: All following statements regarding the privileges of Parliament members are correct except
o: Members individual freedom only allowed, house as a whole do not have freedom
questions.x: Parliamentary privileges belong both to individual members and to each House collectively, so option 4 is wrong.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Article 17 & 18 provide
questions.x: Article 17 (abolition of untouchability) and Article 18 (abolition of titles) secure social equality.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which one of the following is a fundamental right under the constitution of India and a human right as well
questions.x: The right to education is a Fundamental Right under Article 21A and is also a recognised human right.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: In which of the following cases did the Supreme Court direct the compulsory registration of all marriages in India
o: Daniel Lafifi vs Union of India
Ashok Kumar vs Union of India
questions.x: In Seema v. Ashwani Kumar (2006) the Supreme Court ordered compulsory registration of all marriages.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following States has more than one Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha

questions.s: How many States in India are Bicameral in their governance structure
questions.x: In 2017, seven states had Legislative Councils: AP, Telangana, Bihar, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh and J&K. APPSC's final key corrected the answer to 7.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Preamble to the constitution ofIndia promised citizens to provide justice. Choose the correct combination of words used in the preamble for which justice is sought to be secured

questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which one among the following has the power to regulate the right of citizenship in India?
questions.x: Under Article 11, Parliament has the power to regulate the right of citizenship.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which one among the following is not guaranteed by the Constitution of India as a fundamental right?
o: Freedom to move freely throughout the country
Freedom to assemble peacefully without arms
Freedom to own, acquire and dispose a property anywhere in the country
Freedom to practice any trade or profession
questions.x: The freedom to acquire, hold and dispose of property (Article 19(1)(f)) was removed by the 44th Amendment in 1978.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Among the following whose term of office is the longest?
questions.x: The CAG holds office for six years (or until age 65), longer than the five-year terms of the others.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The maximum GAP between two sessions of parliament can be 6 months, which is calculated between
o: Last sitting of one session to the last sitting of the next session
Six calendar months excluding the months in which the sessions are held
Last sitting of one session to the first sitting of the next session
First sitting of two consecutive sessions
questions.x: Under Article 85, six months must not pass between the last sitting of one session and the first sitting of the next.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Next to Uttar Pradesh, which of the following state has the highest number of seats in the Lok Sabha
questions.x: Maharashtra has 48 Lok Sabha seats, second only to Uttar Pradesh's 80.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: With regard to power of pardon available to President and Governer under the Constitution?
o: The power of the President and Governor are one and same
For Offences under concurrent lists, without the role of State, President alone has the pardoning power
The only authority for pardoning a sentence of death is the President
As regard suspension and remission, the Governor does not have concurrent jurisdiction with the President
questions.x: Only the President can pardon a death sentence (Article 72). A Governor can suspend, remit or commute it but not pardon it.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: How many days does the British parliament took to pass the Indian Independence Bill and for bringing it into force
questions.x: APPSC's key says the Indian Independence Bill took about 15 days: introduced on 4 July 1947, it got royal assent on 18 July 1947.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The most outstanding characteristic of the Indian Independence Act was that
o: Act was passed with an intention to retain British authority
It formed a new policy for India
questions.x: APPSC's key says the Act's distinctive feature was that it transferred power without itself giving India a constitution.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Indian Constitution allows to acquire foreign territories. In this regard, out of the following statements identify the correct one?
o: The acquisition does not fall within Article 1 of the Constitution
Acquisition is governed by the International Laws
Acquired foreign territory shall become a part of existing States only
The pre acquisition laws and the rights of acquired therein shall continue
questions.x: APPSC's key says the acquisition of foreign territory is governed by international law.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for a decent standard of life and full enjoyment of leisure and social and cultural opportunities?
questions.x: Article 43 directs the state to secure a living wage, a decent standard of life and full enjoyment of leisure and social and cultural opportunities.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The 73rd Amendment Act which was brought into force in 1993 added following number of articles to the Indian Constitution.
questions.x: The 73rd Amendment added Part IX, Articles 243 to 243-O, which is 16 articles.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The person who got the highest majority in Presidential elections till now is

questions.s: The doctrine of "Paramountcy" is a legal principle:
o: to reconcile conflicting laws where both central government and Provincial governments have the power to create laws in relation to the same matter
To explain the law making authority of the Government
To provide law making authority to the Central government
To explain law making authority of the country
questions.x: The doctrine of paramountcy resolves conflicts between central and provincial laws on the same subject, usually in favour of the central law.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: With regard to officers of All India Services, choose the correct answer from the following
o: A member of an all India Service can be dismissed or removed only by the Union government
A member of an all India service can be dismissed or removed by the State government also if he/she is serving under that State
In India, State government employees administer State laws only
Union government administer Union Laws through its Departments only
questions.x: Under Article 311 and the AIS rules, an All India Service officer can be dismissed or removed only by the Union government.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Relating to the Jammu and Kashmir, identify the wrong answer from the following
o: All the provisions of the Constitution of India relating to the States in the First Schedule are not applicable to J&K
J&K forms a part of the territory of India as defined in Art 1 of the Constitution
Through accession, the domain of India acquired jurisdiction over the J&K with respect to subjects of Defence, External Affairs and Communications
Like other States of India in the case of J&K also residuary powers shall vest with Parliament
questions.x: Under the Article 370 arrangement of the time, residuary powers in Jammu & Kashmir lay with the state, not with Parliament.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the amendment of the Constitution all following statements are correct, except
o: According to Article 368, Parliament ofIndia can amend any part of the Constitution
Article 2 of the Constitution empowered the Parliament ofIndia to admit new states into the Union
with reference to Article 2 or 3 the amendment of the provisions of FIRST and FOURTH schedule shall not be deemed to be an amendment of theConstitution for the purpose of Article 368
The territories of the units of the federation may be altered or re distributed by the Parliament without intimation to the States
questions.x: Under Article 3, a bill to alter state boundaries must first be referred to the state legislature for its views, so it cannot be done without intimation.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: With regards to fundamental rights, all statements below are correct, except
o: The rights reserved for citizens are denied to the aliens
Aliens are divided into friendly aliens and enemy aliens
Indian Constitution shows no difference between friendly aliens and enemy aliens
questions.x: The Constitution does distinguish between them: Article 22(3) denies preventive-detention safeguards to enemy aliens.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution explain about the citizenship?
questions.x: APPSC's key gives Articles 5 to 8, the provisions on who became a citizen at the commencement of the Constitution.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Indian Parliament passes legislations subject to the following limitations and prohibitions
questions.x: Parliament's law-making is limited by the federal distribution of powers in the Seventh Schedule.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: All statements below related to Fundamental Rights are correct except
o: In India the power to impose limitations on Fundamental Rights has been conferred upon the Supreme Court
Judiciary determines the reasonableness of the restrictions imposed by the Legislature
If anybody's property is taken away by the executive fiat with due authority of law or intervention of a law, the aggrieved individual has no right to move the Supreme Court under Article 32
questions.x: The power to impose reasonable restrictions on Fundamental Rights lies with the legislature, not the Supreme Court. Courts only judge whether the restrictions are reasonable.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is not the Supreme Court's evolution?
questions.x: Basic structure, PIL and the ban on routine handcuffing grew out of Supreme Court rulings. 'Exemptions to Fundamental Rights' are in the Constitution's text.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which one of the following is not a Constitutional Body?

questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: All following statements regarding Backward Classes are correct, except?
o: The word 'Backward Classes of Citizens' is defined in the Constitution
The Backward Classes contemplated under Art 16(4)are mainly social. It need not be both social and educational
By clause (10)of the Article 338 "Backward Classes" are included within expression "Scheduled Caste"
Indra Sawhney case is related to "Backward Classes"
questions.x: The Constitution does not define 'backward classes of citizens', so option 1 is wrong (APPSC's final key for the English version).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The constitution of India provides certain protections to citizens.In this regard, all statements below are correct, except
o: No person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once
Parliament of India shall be competent to make a criminal law with retrospective effect
No person accused of any offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself
Safeguards provided in Article 22 are not available to a person arrested or detained under preventive Detention law
questions.x: Article 20(1) bars ex post facto criminal laws, so Parliament cannot make a criminal law with retrospective effect.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Constitution of India grants religious freedom to the citizens. In this regard,all statements below are correct except
o: Right to religion is available to Indian citizens without any limitations
The State will not compel any citizen to pay any taxes for the promotion of any particular religion
Religious instructions are totally banned in State owned educational institutions
In Non-State owned educational institutions religious instruction is not totally prohibited but it must not be imposed upon people of other religions without their consent
questions.x: Religious freedom under Articles 25 and 26 is subject to public order, morality, health and other Fundamental Rights. It is not unlimited.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: An election to fill the vacancy caused by the expiration of the term of the President must be completed before the expiration of term. In case there is delay
o: Vice President who shall act as President
Chief Justice of India shall act as President
Out going President must continue to hold office until his successor assumess office
Senior most Judge of Supreme court acts as President
questions.x: Under Article 56(1)(c), the outgoing President continues in office until the successor takes charge.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: In India executive have the power to legislate by Ordinances. But Legislature shall approve it otherwise the ordinance can exist at most
questions.x: An ordinance lapses six weeks after Parliament reassembles, and the gap between sessions can be up to six months, so the maximum life is six months and six weeks.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: India is following Parliamentary form of government. In this regard all statements given below are correct, except
o: The collective responsibility is to the house of the people even though some of the ministers may be the members of the Council of the States
The President of India is the real head of the executive
Ministers shall be individually responsible to the President and shall be liable to dismissal evenwhen they may have the confidence ofthe Legislature
In a parliamentary form of government, the tenure of office of the council of ministers is dependent on the will of the legislature
questions.x: In a parliamentary system the President is the nominal head. Real executive power lies with the Council of Ministers.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the Comptroller and Auditor General, out of the given below, choose the wrong answer.
o: Comptroller and Auditor General controls the entire financial system of the country related to the Union government only
The term of office of the Comptroller and Auditor General shall be 6 years
Comptroller and Auditor General vacates the office upon attaining the age of 65 years even without completing 6 years term
Comptroller and Auditor General's salary shall be equal to that of judge of Supreme Court
questions.x: The CAG audits the accounts of both the Union and the states and does not control the financial system, so option 1 is wrong.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The period between the prorogation of Parliament and its reassembly in a new session is termed
questions.x: APPSC's key calls the gap between prorogation and reassembly in a new session a 'recess'.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: If a person incurs any of the disqualifications mentioned in Article 102, his seat will there upon be
o: Vacant after the recommendation of the house concernd
Vacant on the recommendation of Election Commissioner
questions.x: APPSC's key says the seat becomes vacant immediately once a member incurs an Article 102 disqualification.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: When a no-confidence motion for removal of the Lok Sabha Speaker is under consideration, all the following statements are correct, except
o: Speaker shall not preside the Lok Sabha proceedings
Speaker has the right to speak
Speaker has the right to take part in the proceeding
Speaker shall have right of vote and exercise a casting vote in case of equality of votes
questions.x: Under Article 96 the Speaker may vote in the first instance during a removal motion but has no casting vote, so option 4 is wrong. APPSC's final key confirms option 4.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the National Emergency all following statements are correct, except that the President can
o: Reduce the transfer of Finances from Centre to States
Cancel the transfer of Finances from the Centre to States
National Emergency may be imposed for entire Nation or a part of India
Increase the transfer of Finances from Centre to States
questions.x: During a National Emergency the President can reduce or cancel transfers of finances to the states (Article 354), not increase them.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: An official corresponding post to the Attorney General of India at the State level is
questions.x: The Advocate General (Article 165) is the state-level counterpart of the Attorney General.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the composition of the Legislative Council, all following statements are correct, except
o: 1/3 of the total number of Council shall be elected from local bodies
1/12 of the total number of Council shall be elected by Teachers
1/12 of the total number of Council shall be elected by Graduates
1/13 of the total number of Council shall be elected by Legislative Assembly
questions.x: One-third of a Legislative Council's members are elected by the MLAs, not one-thirteenth.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: As per the Constitution, Governor has the power to nominate one member from Anglo Indian community. Such reservation will cease on the expiration of
questions.x: Under Article 334 as it then stood, reservation for nominated Anglo-Indians was to end in 2020.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: If any member of a State Legislature has become subject to any of the disqualifications mentioned in Art 192, the question shall be referred to
o: Speaker of the concerned State Assembly
questions.x: Under Article 192, questions of an MLA's disqualification go to the Governor, who acts on the Election Commission's opinion.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which one of the following Regional Party emerged as the largest opposition Party in the Lok Sabha elections held in 1984
o: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
questions.x: In the 1984 Lok Sabha elections the Telugu Desam Party won 30 seats and became the largest opposition party.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: In case the Union Cabinet requests the President for the Joint Sitting of the Parliament to pass a Bill and President in his discretion does not summon a Joint Sitting
o: Council of Ministers may once again request for the Joint Sitting
Each house can again pass the bill separately
The Bill will come to an end
The President has no such power
questions.x: APPSC's key says that if no joint sitting is summoned, the bill comes to an end.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: With regard to the administration of Scheduled and Tribal areas, all following statements are correct, except
o: Provisions for Tribal areas administration are found in Sixth Schedule of the Constitution
Governor is not authorized to direct that any particular Act ofParliament or of the Legislature of a State shall not apply to Schedule area
The Governor is authorized make to regulations to prohibit or restrict the transfer of land in Tribal area
The Provisions of the Constitution relating to the administration of the Schedule area and Tribes may be altered by the Parliament by ordinary legislation
questions.x: Under the Fifth Schedule the Governor can direct that an Act of Parliament or of the state legislature shall not apply to a Scheduled Area, so option 2 is wrong (English-version key).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the appellate jurisdiction of the Supreme Court all statements are correct, except
o: Appeal lies with the Supreme Courtin the cases involving interpretation of the Constitution-- Civil, Criminal or others
Appeal lies with the Supreme Court in Civil cases irrespective of any Constitutional question
The Supreme Court's power for granting Special Leave Petition is limited and can be curtailed through a Constitutional Amendment
Parliament has no power to make any law conferring on Supreme Court further powers to hear Appeals from Criminal matters
questions.x: Article 134(2) lets Parliament by law give the Supreme Court further powers to hear criminal appeals, so option 4 is wrong.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is not a federal feature of the Indian Constitution?
questions.x: The CAG is a unitary feature common to the Union and the states, not a federal one.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: All statements regarding the Roles/Functions/Responsibilities of the Finance Commission are correct, except
o: The Commission recommends sharing of net proceeds of taxes between the Centre and States
Recommending the principles for governing the grant-in-Aid to the States by the Centre
Recommendation on the matters referred to it by the President for the interest of sound Finance
Maintains the income and expenditure details of Centre and State Governments
questions.x: The Finance Commission recommends tax sharing and grants. It does not keep the governments' income and expenditure accounts.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: According to the Article 233, the appointment of a district Judge shall be done by
o: The President in consultation with the High court of the State concerned
The Governor of the state concerned in consultation with the High court of the state concerned
The Governor of the state concerned, in consultation with the Chief Justice of India
The Collegium of the High court
questions.x: Under Article 233, district judges are appointed by the Governor in consultation with the High Court.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: In which year "None of the above" (NOTA)button was introduced in Electronic Voting Machines
questions.x: NOTA was introduced on EVMs in 2013, after the Supreme Court's PUCL judgment.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Regarding the Election Commission of India, all following statements are correct, except
o: The members of Election Commission do not have equal powers with Chief Election Commissioner
Disputes related to the Election are not decided by the Election Commission only
The Election Commission of India enjoys Constitutional status
Keeping the voters list updated at all times is the responsibility of Elections Commission
questions.x: Election Commissioners have the same powers and salary as the CEC, and decisions are by majority, so option 1 is wrong.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Find out the wrong statement regarding the Punchhi Commission Recommendations
o: Punchhi Commission was constituted by the UPA government to study Centre State relations
The Commission recommended that Governor nominee should not have participated in active politics at least for a couple of years previous to his appointment
The Commission recommended that there is no need to amend Article 355 and 356
The Commission also criticised arbitrary dismissal of Governor
questions.x: The Punchhi Commission did recommend amending Articles 355 and 356, for example to allow localised emergencies, so option 3 is wrong.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Under Which Article of the Constitution of India can the Fundamental Rights of the members of the Armed forces be specifically restricted
questions.x: Article 33 lets Parliament restrict the Fundamental Rights of members of the armed forces.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to regulate the rights of the citizens
questions.x: APPSC deleted this question in the final key.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The correct form of the address for the President of India is
questions.x: APPSC's key gives 'His Excellency' as the form of address for the President.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is not one of the recommendation of the Rajmannar Committee.
o: Curb on the misuse of Art 356
questions.x: The Rajamannar Committee (1969) wanted to curb the Centre's powers, including over Governors, not to strengthen the Governor system.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Doctrine of "Parens Patriae" means
o: Authority regarded as the legal protection of citizens unable to protect themselves
An inconsistency or contradiction between two or more parts of legal instruments
Parliament has no power to make loss with respect to any matter which belongs to states
It is the duty of the court to interpret the legislation made by parliament
questions.x: Parens patriae means the state acts as guardian of those unable to protect themselves.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: During British rule in India, Indian states had freedom in internal administration but had no international life. But the British interfered in internal administration under the following conditions
o: For giving effect to its international commitments
on the request of the Congress party
On the request of the people
questions.x: APPSC's key says the British intervened in the princely states to give effect to their international commitments.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is the procedure to abolish or create Legislative Council in a State
o: On the recommendation of State Legislature bypassing a resolution with 2/3 majority, followed by an act of parliament
questions.x: Under Article 169, the state assembly passes a resolution by special majority and Parliament then passes a law.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Chief Minister of a State is not eligible to vote in the Presidential elections if he is a
o: Member of Legislative Council of the State Legislature
Member of Legislative Assembly of the State Legislature
questions.x: Only elected MLAs vote in presidential elections, so a Chief Minister who sits in the Legislative Council cannot vote.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: When an Election is held for the Legislature which has been dissolved before expiry of its term, it is known as
questions.x: An election held after a legislature is dissolved before its term ends is a mid-term election.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Maximum number of votes that can be recorded by an Electronic Voting Machine record is
questions.x: The EVMs then in use could record at most 3,840 votes.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: What option can be exercised by the Government and Legislature, when they do not like a decision of the Supreme Court.
o: Changing the judges of the Supreme Court
Pass a Constitutional amendment or pass a law to overcome the decision
Supreme Court's decision is final and ultimate and cannot be challenged
questions.x: Government and Parliament can overcome a Supreme Court ruling by a constitutional amendment or by a new law that removes its basis.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: National voter's day is now celebrated on
questions.x: National Voters' Day is observed on 25 January, the Election Commission's foundation day.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The SarkariaCommission dealing with Centre - State relations has not recommended the following regarding the appointment of Governor
o: Provide a secure 5 years term for Governor
A person who is not the native of a State shall be appointed as Governor of the State
The Governor must be some eminent person in some field
The Governor should have travelled extensively in and around of in the state
questions.x: The Sarkaria Commission said nothing about a Governor having travelled widely in the state. The other conditions were its recommendations.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: During the period of ruling, the ruling party makes use of the following to win the voters in their favour, except
questions.x: APPSC's final key accepts options 1, 2 and 3: under the Model Code of Conduct a ruling party must not use government servants, vehicles or discretionary grants to win votes.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following bodies concerned with Inter State relations are Constitutional bodies
questions.x: The Inter-State Council (Article 263) is a constitutional body. Zonal Councils and river water tribunals are statutory. APPSC's final key gives option 2.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who among the following was the Chairman of the Union Constitution committee of the Constituent Assembly?
questions.x: Jawaharlal Nehru chaired the Union Constitution Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is not a tool of Legislative control over the administration in India?
questions.x: Dissolution of the House is an executive power, not a tool for the legislature to control administration.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: "Persons may change but rules should not change" is the principle of
questions.x: Rule by fixed laws rather than by persons is the principle of constitutional government.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Locate the Constitutional power which enabled the Central government to Legislate on caw slaughter
o: Entry 17, list 3 in schedule for prevention of cruelty to animals
questions.x: Article 48 of the Directive Principles calls for prohibiting cow slaughter, and APPSC's key treats it as the source of that power.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution
